text: Integration requirements for docs/plans/terminal-workspace.md: existing JobMonitor already owns narrow background watches. Share scheduling/known-job collection with A3 rather than adding overlapping pollers; preserve legacy conditions/notifications. Add idempotent scoped workspace subscriptions usable by view/connect --view, and support the V2 bounded, coalesced inspect queue and expiring log leases. View exit removes only viewer leases; explicit monitor removal affects only the selected subscription. All producers must target the same local config/state namespace. No implementation performed in this planning task.
